decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-120213 Critical Path Traversal in Fastify HTTP Proxy
decisions.reason: Critical CVSS 9.1 path traversal in fastify/http-proxy v9.0.0-11.6.5. Verified at radar.offseq.com primary source.

provenance.evidence: CVE-2026-120213: unauthenticated remote attacker can use backslash-based dot-segments to bypass path restriction and reach upstream locations outside intended prefix.
